body:
Joint TermAl+Engram restart plan, agreed between Termal::Fable2 and Engram::Fable on 2026-11-17 ~05:21Z (ebe242f7 #8172/#8173).
1. TermAl: Opus2 installs the bundle (65a11f06..b04862a9, plus anything landing later) at target/release/termal.exe, outside any gate window, before the moment. Opus2 reports the installed hash to Fable2.
2. Engram: the Merger lands and pushes the restart set (R18u+ea4a+606e; builds were on eecabd6a at 05:21Z). Engram::Fable then sends Fable2 the landed commit, the build fingerprint and "Engram install ready".
3. Fable2 sets the moment. The Merger installs the new engram.exe a few minutes BEFORE it, keeping the old one as backup.
4. Fable2 sends Greg ONE "restart now" via Engram::Asistant, with both hashes and the reasons. Reasons: the Comovo sync prerequisite (w-4438 fix in dd205), the TermAl coord-store boot fix, the workspace-delete popup.
5. After the restart, once no pre-install engram process remains, the Merger runs `engram doctor --repair-projections` on every live store.
Then the Comovo bootstrap can start (memory comovo-mac-after-sync-plan-2026-11-17).
